project.name: Green Performance Score (GPS)
project.description: A weighted composite score (0-100) measuring country-level emissions and energy performance, normalized for development level. GPS is emissions-only — policy data is supplementary context.
project.track: Climate, Environmental Justice, and Sustainable Development
project.question: Which types of climate policies are associated with statistically significant reductions in national CO2 emissions after implementation?

gps.formula: Weighted sum of 3 emissions & energy components (weights adjustable). No policy scores in GPS.

co2Trend.name: CO2/Capita Trend
co2Trend.method: OLS slope of 5-year rolling average CO2 per capita (2015-2024), normalized by baseline.

carbonIntensity.name: Carbon Intensity Trend
carbonIntensity.method: OLS slope of CO2 per unit GDP (2015-2024). Measures decoupling of emissions from economic growth.
carbonIntensity.unit: tonnes CO2 per million USD GDP

cleanEnergy.name: Clean Energy Growth
cleanEnergy.method: Average year-over-year growth rate of installed clean energy capacity (solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, bioenergy, nuclear).

scoring.missingDataHandling: If any component is unavailable, its weight is redistributed proportionally to available components.

supplementaryPolicyScores.note: These are computed for context but do NOT feed into the GPS composite.

pis.name: Policy Intensity
pis.description: log(active policies) x diversity multiplier (topic + family coverage).

pes.name: Policy Effectiveness
pes.description: Per-country before/after analysis around policy implementation dates, recency-weighted.

prs.name: Policy Recency
prs.description: Recent legislative activity (post-2020) with dormancy penalty.

peerNormalization.description: All components are percentile-ranked within World Bank income groups. This controls for development level bias.

emissions.source: Our World in Data / Global Carbon Budget
emissions.unit: tonnes CO2 per person (territorial, fossil only)

energy.source: Global Energy Monitor — Global Integrated Power Tracker (Feb 2026)

gdp.source: World Bank — GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$)

policies.note: Policy data is supplementary context, not part of GPS.

apiFiles.countries.json: All country GPS scores, 3 components, and supplementary policy counts. Main entry point.
apiFiles.timeseries/{ISO3}.json: Per-country time series: emissions, energy capacity, carbon intensity, policy timeline. Load on demand.
apiFiles.timeseries_index.json: List of all available country ISO3 codes for time series.
apiFiles.effectiveness.json: Supplementary policy analysis by topic and family, plus per-country breakdowns for radar charts.
apiFiles.metadata.json: This file. Schema, methodology, grade thresholds, data source documentation.
